agyos_skill.intent: Discover container images, inspect repository metadata and tags, verify image architectures, create repositories, and query Docker Hardened Images using the official Docker Hub MCP server (docker/hub-mcp).
agyos_skill.instructions: Bridge Docker Hub directly into AI agent workflows using the official Docker Hub Model Context Protocol server (`docker/hub-mcp`). Enables agents to search public and private repositories, verify tag existence and multi-architecture platform variants, manage repository descriptions, and query certified Docker Hardened Images. The server supports both anonymous access (public repository discovery) and authenticated access (full repository management and private content inspection). The launcher script [`docker-hub-mcp.sh`](file:///home/ai/Documents/projects/Freelance/AGYOS/mcp/docker-hub-mcp.sh) resolves credentials in this order: - **Personal Access Token (PAT):** 1. `HUB_PAT_TOKEN`, `DOCKERHUB_PAT`, or `DOCKER_HUB_PAT` environment variable 2. `~/.config/docker-hub-mcp/token` (file permission `600`) - **Docker Hub Username:** 1. `DOCKER_HUB_USERNAME` or `DOCKERHUB_USERNAME` environment variable 2. `~/.config/docker-hub-mcp/username` (plain text) To store credentials securely: ```bash mkdir -p ~/.config/docker-hub-mcp echo -n "dckr_pat_your_token_here" > ~/.config/docker-hub-mcp/token chmod 600 ~/.config/docker-hub-mcp/token echo -n "your_docker_username" > ~/.config/docker-hub-mcp/username ``` The server runs via either: 1. Containerized execution using the official Docker Hub image `mcp/dockerhub` (`docker run -i --rm mcp/dockerhub --transport=stdio`). 2. Local compiled Node.js build (`node integrations/hub-mcp/dist/index.js --transport=stdio`). | Tool | Purpose | Read/Write | Parameters | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `search` | Search repositories on Docker Hub by keyword, filter by operating system and architecture | Read | `query` (string), `page` (number), `page_size` (number) | | `checkRepository` | Verify whether a specific repository exists in a namespace | Read | `namespace` (string), `repository` (string) | | `checkRepositoryTag` | Verify whether a specific tag exists for a repository | Read | `namespace` (string), `repository` (string), `tag` (string) | | `getRepositoryInfo` | Retrieve repository metadata, description, pull count, and star count | Read | `namespace` (string), `repository` (string) |
